title: Neo4j delta sync: unchanged, edited, added and removed rows; forced full uploads

cases.title: baseline Neo4j node count
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(n)

cases.title: baseline Neo4j edge count
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project})-[r]->(:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(r)

cases.title: …still in sync; last_sync is a no-op delta, skipped, or unchanged (record the text)
…node count unchanged
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(n)

cases.title: EDIT: change round_cents' docstring (same symbols, same ids)

a docstring edit is a small delta confined to the edited file: the incremental route re-creates that file's nodes with fresh ids (contentless FTS rows are never reused), so they show as a few adds and removes; nothing else moves (measured +4 -4 nodes on a 137-node graph)
…node count unchanged by the in-place update
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(n)

cases.title: …edge count unchanged
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project})-[r]->(:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(r)

cases.title: …the new docstring reached Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, name: 'round_cents'}) RETURN n.properties_json

cases.title: …hub still has 12 callers (untouched rows were not rewritten or lost)
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (c:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project})-[:CALLS]->(h:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, name: 'hub'}) RETURN count(c)

cases.title: ADD: a new file with two functions
…sync succeeded as delta or full (adding a file may renumber ids: record which)
…the new functions are in Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) WHERE n.name IN ['extra_one', 'extra_two'] RETURN n.name ORDER BY n.name

cases.title: …the new CALLS edge extra_two -> extra_one is in Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (a:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, name: 'extra_two'})-[:CALLS]->(b:CbmNode {name: 'extra_one'}) RETURN count(*)

cases.title: …the removed rows are gone from Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project}) WHERE n.name IN ['extra_one', 'extra_two'] RETURN count(n)

cases.title: …node count is back to the baseline
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(n)

cases.title: …no orphaned relationships remain under the project
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (a:CbmNode {db: $project})-[r]->(b:CbmNode {db: $project}) WHERE a.gen <> p.gen OR b.gen <> p.gen RETURN count(r)

cases.title: restore money.py to the fixture text
…DELTA-EDIT is gone from Neo4j
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project, name: 'round_cents'}) RETURN n.properties_json CONTAINS 'DELTA-EDIT'

cases.title: FORCED FULL: remove the local delta state file
with the state file gone, also change a source file so a sync is needed
cases.content: # eval: force a source change so the sync is not skipped as unchanged

cases.title: …the sync was a full upload and says why
…the full upload rewrote the state file (about 30-40 bytes per row)
cases.shell: {{python}} -c "import os,sys; p=sys.argv[1]+'.neo4j-state.db'; print('state_exists', os.path.exists(p), os.path.getsize(p) if os.path.exists(p) else 0)" "{{db_path}}"

cases.title: …counts are the baseline again
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project, gen: p.gen, project: $project}) RETURN count(n)

cases.title: …and the old generation was deleted
cases.cypher: MATCH (p:CbmProject {name: $project}) MATCH (n:CbmNode {db: $project}) WHERE n.gen <> p.gen RETURN count(n)

cases.title: DELTA OFF: restart the daemon with CBM_NEO4J_DELTA_MAX_ROWS=0
…edit a docstring again
…with the delta off the sync is full
restore strings.py
DELTA ON: restart the daemon without the variable
the working copy is clean again (git sees no change)
